remediation.analysis: The route reflects `req.query.name` directly into an HTML response via string concatenation. If `name` contains HTML/JS (e.g., `<script>`), it will be interpreted by the browser, enabling reflected XSS (CWE-79).
remediation.remediation_strategy: Apply output encoding for the HTML context before embedding user-controlled data into the response. Use a minimal inline HTML-escape function to neutralize characters that can break out of text context (`& < > " '`). Preserve the existing response structure and behavior (still returns an `<h1>` greeting).
assumptions: The greeting should continue to render HTML with the provided name displayed as text (not as HTML).
